summary: Core Scientific, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of Polaris DS LLC, a Nevada LLC, via merger with its wholly owned subsidiary Polar Merger Sub, LLC. The aggregate cash purchase price was approximately $444.3 million, subject to post-closing adjustments, with a potential additional $40 million if 40 MW of firm electric capacity becomes available. The merger agreement was dated May 5, 2026, with the target surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. This represents consummation of a previously announced transaction; watch for post-closing adjustments and integration execution.
